key: Well, I think it's about time I hang up my hat.
en: Well, I think it's about time I hang up my hat.
ja: さて、そろそろ潮時かねぇ。

key: With the water like this and no sign of changing, I reckon my sailing days are over.
en: With the water like this and no sign of changing, I reckon my sailing days are over.
ja: この水の様子じゃ、変わる気配もないし、俺の航海も終わりだろうな。

key: I think there's only one thing for a reasonable man like me to do now--
en: I think there's only one thing for a reasonable man like me to do now--
ja: 分別ある男として、今やるべきことは一つしかねえ――
やまおとこにでもなるとするか。

key: To that end, I'd like to get some kind of Pokémon that can keep a look out on the trails for me.
en: To that end, I'd like to get some kind of Pokémon that can keep a look out on the trails for me.
ja: そのためにも、山道の見張りをしてくれるようなポケモンが欲しいんだ。

key: Heard Watchog is good for that.
en: Heard Watchog is good for that.
ja: ミルホッグがそういうのに向いてるって聞いたんだがな。

key: Don't suppose you've got one, Trainer?
en: Don't suppose you've got one, Trainer?
ja: トレーナーさん、一匹持ってたりしないか?

key: If you do, I'll trade you for my Nosepass-- given that I won't need it to be my compass in sailing anymore.
en: If you do, I'll trade you for my Nosepass-- given that I won't need it to be my compass in sailing anymore.
ja: 持ってるなら、俺のノズパスと交換してくれ――もう航海の羅針盤には必要ないからな。

key: I'll keep a look out myself.
en: I'll keep a look out myself.
ja: 見張りは自分でやるとするか。

key: Coming through with flying colors! Let's ship off.
en: Coming through with flying colors! Let's ship off.
ja: 上出来だ! さあ、出航しよう。
\PNはミルホッグとノズパスを交換した!

key: I'll make preparations immediately! Your help is much appreciated, young one!
en: I'll make preparations immediately! Your help is much appreciated, young one!
ja: すぐに準備するとしよう! 助かったぜ、若いの!

key: As a Hiker, I'd like to get some kind of Pokémon that can keep a look out on the trails for me.
en: As a Hiker, I'd like to get some kind of Pokémon that can keep a look out on the trails for me.
ja: やまおとことして、山道の見張りをしてくれるようなポケモンが欲しいんだ。

key: Come to think of it, perhaps a compass is useful for hiking as well...
en: Come to think of it, perhaps a compass is useful for hiking as well...
ja: 考えてみりゃ、山歩きにも羅針盤くらいは役に立つかもな……
